summary: Steel tower, 30 m, built 2017 per Alberta's wildfire register; listed active with road access and a weather station. No tower-specific history found.

staffing.status: observer on duty, generally April to October (Alberta's description of its 127 lookout sites)

access.note: Register lists the tower as active with drive access (ACCESS_MODE drive). No source describes public visits.

events.note: Register gives 2017 as the construction year for the steel tower.

evidence.supports: Rocky record: steel tower, built 2017, 30 m tall, elevation 1,106 m
Rocky record: coordinates about 52.52 N, 114.88 W
Rocky record: has a weather station
Alberta places lookouts where visibility is favourable to detect and report wildfires
evidence.quote: located where visibility is favourable to detect and report wildfires

evidence.supports: Alberta has 127 wildfire lookout sites in the boreal forest and along the Rockies
evidence.quote: 127 wildfire lookout sites are located throughout Alberta's boreal forest and along the Rocky Mountains.

evidence.supports: each site is staffed by an observer, generally April to October
evidence.quote: Each site is staffed by a lookout observer whose job is to watch for wildfire all day, each day, generally from April to October.

evidence.supports: observer's main duty is early detection of smoke and fires
evidence.quote: provide early detection of smoke and fires

evidence.supports: observers report smoke, fire and lightning observations
evidence.quote: report smoke, fire and lightning observations

corrections.why: Register lists the tower as active with drive access (ACCESS_MODE drive). No source says it is closed. Restricted fits a staffed station where no public visits are described.

sources.title: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta (WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT), FIRES database extract

notes_for_editor: Register-only record for this tower: no tower-specific page or news item found in two searches. Brief lists access as closed; the register shows drive access and an active status, so the story uses restricted (see corrections). The brief has no local_unit for this tower, so the story names no municipality. Staffing text is Alberta's program-wide description of its 127 sites, not a tower-specific record.
